review_description: Local Supplier who I heard good things about. Was able to install within two weeks of placing order. No deposit required. He was not happy with the position of the panels after install so one week later he returned to move them to increase sun exposure. Will also return when we receive our 1st electricity bill to make certain the system is performing to its full potential. 12 Q Cell 255w panels and 3KW SMA inverter, Total cost including electrician, $6498.00. He is a one man show being supplier and installer. No big companies to deal with. Very happy.
